# tinker sld

> A small playground app by Richard Hess, built with Solid 2.0. Pick a colour,
> generate random data values, and reset them. No accounts and no server.

The page at / is a Solid single-page app and renders nothing useful without
JavaScript. Use this file instead of scraping it.

## How it works

- Static files on Vercel, built with Vite and `@solidjs/vite-plugin`.
- One shared Solid store holds the picked colour, a counter and the data
  values. Refresh generates new random values (0–99) and bumps the counter;
  Reset restores the sample values. Nothing is saved between visits.
